title: SCOPE: Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.38391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides coarse supervision for long-horizon LLM agents: failed trajectories may contain correct steps, while successful trajectories can contain errors. Trajectory-level skills can also shift teacher preferences at unrelated steps, introducing off-target distillation signals. We introduce SCOPE, a framework for Selective Critical-Step On-Policy Self-Distillation. After a supervised warm-up, the policy analyzes its own trajectories, generates step-specific hindsight skills, and distills their guidance only at selected error steps. A bounded signed teacher-student coefficient stabilizes auxiliary updates while preserving positive reinforcement and negative correction. A success-relative pairwise length reward further encourages efficient task completion. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple model backbones. With Qwen2.5-3B, SCOPE achieves 97.7% success

translated_title: SCOPE：面向智能体强化学习的选择性关键步骤同策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于结果的强化学习为长时程LLM智能体提供的是粗粒度监督：失败的轨迹中可能包含正确的步骤，而成功的轨迹中也可能存在错误。此外，轨迹级别的技能还可能在无关步骤上改变教师模型的偏好，从而引入偏离目标的蒸馏信号。我们提出了SCOPE，一个选择性关键步骤同策略自蒸馏框架。在监督预热之后，策略会分析自身的轨迹，生成针对特定步骤的事后技能，并仅在选定的错误步骤上蒸馏其指导信息。一个有界的带符号师生系数在稳定辅助更新的同时，保留了正向强化和负向纠正的作用。一个基于成功的成对长度奖励进一步鼓励智能体高效地完成任务。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，该方法在多个模型骨干上取得了一致的性能提升。使用Qwen2.5-3B时，SCOPE达到了97.7%的成功率。
tldr: SCOPE框架让策略自我分析轨迹并仅在关键错误步骤上进行同策略自蒸馏，结合有界带符号师生系数和成功相对长度奖励，显著提升了长时程LLM智能体强化学习的效果。
en_tdlr: SCOPE enables on-policy self-distillation by analyzing the policy's own trajectories and distilling guidance only at selected critical error steps, combined with a bounded signed teacher-student coefficient and a success-relative pairwise length reward, achieving consistent gains for agentic reinforcement learning on ALFWorld and WebShop.
